### 1. Teresa Carles
* **Location:** Carrer de Jovellanos, 2, Ciutat Vella (El Raval), Barcelona  
* **Menu & Details:** [Teresa Carles Official Website](https://teresacarles.com) | [TheFork Listing](https://www.thefork.com/restaurant/teresa-carles-r2240)  
* **Cuisine:** Vegetarian / Catalan-Mediterranean plant-forward

**Dishes Under EUR 25:**
* **Las bravas de Teresa** — €5.75  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Roasted potato, carrot, beetroot, and sweet potato served with chipotle and cilantro mayonnaise.
* **Ensalada César** — €13.50  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Romaine lettuce, shredded carrot, plant-based "chicken", croutons, nut-based "parmesan", and Caesar dressing.
* **Ensalada Italiana** — €12.50  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Arugula, avocado, sun-dried tomatoes, white asparagus, parmesan cheese, and basil pesto.
*(Note: Weekday set lunch menus and monthly lunch specials are also typically offered for approximately €15–€17 per person).*

**Review Observations:**
* *Positive:* Diners consistently praise the warm, stylish dining room and creative interpretations of traditional Mediterranean cuisine.
* *Negative/Context:* Can get quite crowded at peak lunch hours, making advance table reservations advisable. A few patrons have noted that select starters occasionally lean oily or heavy.

---

### 2. Biocenter
* **Location:** Carrer del Pintor Fortuny, 25, Ciutat Vella (El Raval), Barcelona  
* **Menu & Details:** [Biocenter Official Website](https://restaurantebiocenter.es) | [TheFork Listing](https://www.thefork.com/restaurant/biocenter-r10777)  
* **Cuisine:** Traditional Vegetarian / Organic Home-Style

**Dishes / Lunch Options Under EUR 25:**
* **Menú del Día (Weekday Lunch Set)** — €16.50 (listed at €16–€16.50 per guest; Saturday set €21.00)  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Daily changing multi-course lunch consisting of a starter (soup or salad), a hot main plate, and dessert.
* **Seitán casero marinado a la plancha** — Included in set menu / à la carte (under €16.00)  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* House-made seitan grilled on the flat-top, topped with Argentine-style chimichurri sauce, and served with roasted potatoes.
* **"Va De Curry"** — Included in set menu / à la carte (under €16.00)  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Tofu and pumpkin simmered in a coconut milk spiced curry sauce served over grains.

**Review Observations:**
* *Positive:* Highly regarded for its unpretentious, comforting whole-food approach, generous set portions, and attentive staff.
* *Negative/Context:* The interior has a vintage, rustic feel that might feel dated compared to trendier cafes; some reviewers mention certain sauces can occasionally lean overly acidic or lemony.

---

### 3. Fat Veggies
* **Location:** Carrer de Bailèn, 83, Eixample Dreta, Barcelona  
* **Menu & Details:** [Fat Veggies Official Menu](https://www.laoficinatropical.com/fatveggies)  
* **Cuisine:** Smoked & Fermented Creative Vegetarian

**Dishes Under EUR 25:**
* **Fat Vegetarian Tacos** — €9.00–€14.00 (individual plates typically €8.00–€16.00; full tasting menu €40.00)  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Corn tortillas loaded with charcoal-smoked vegetables, romesco sauce, and house-fermented pickles.
* **White Bean Hummus & Focaccia** — €7.50–€11.00  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Smooth puréed white bean spread infused with smoke and seasonal seasonings, served with grilled artisan focaccia.
* **Green Lentil Curry** — €13.00–€16.00  
  *Ingredients & preparation:* Black/green lentils cooked in spiced herbal green curry broth with seasonal charred greens.

**Review Observations:**
* *Positive:* Diners love the inventive smokiness, charred vegetable textures, and bold house ferments.
* *Negative/Context:* Portions are mostly sharing-plate sized rather than traditional single-plate entrées, and tables are tight during peak service.

---

### Recommendation & Dining Note
* **Top Pick:** For a classic, central Barcelona lunch experience with great value, head to **Biocenter** or **Teresa Carles** for their weekday *menú del día* specials (usually under €17 for a multi-course meal).
* **Consequential Gap:** Menu items change seasonally at plant-based venues like Fat Veggies and Teresa Carles based on local market produce, so specific side ingredients and daily set items may vary slightly upon arrival.
